A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

UCN- 01, a novel protein kinase C (PKC) inhibitor, inhibits DNA repair through the NER pathway by interfering with the XPA- ERCC1 interaction and the phosphorylation/ dephosphoryation of a 52-kDa XPA- bound protein, which is likely to play a key role in NER.
the UCN-01-induced inhibition of DNA repair activity is associated with the disruption of the interaction of the XPA protein with its binding partner ERCC1.

UCN-1 inhibits NER, and this inhibition is associated with the attenuation of the XPA and ERCCI interaction.
